name: describe_maftools_mcp
description:
Return a Markdown overview explaining what Maftools-MCP can do.
Use this tool when the user asks what this MCP supports,
what analyses it can perform, or how to use it.

name: maftools_docs
description:
Return the Maftools-MCP documentation link.

Use this tool when the user asks for:
- documentation
- guide
- link
- help
- how to use Maftools-MCP
- what this MCP can do

Documentation:
https://reurl.cc/np64QD

name: merge_annovar_to_maf
description:
Convert multiple ANNOVAR multianno(.txt) files into a single merged MAF file.
Supports glob patterns in `annovar_files`, e.g. ["/app/outputs/OSCC/*.hg19_multianno.txt"].

name: merge_maf_to_mafobj
description: Merge multiple MAF files into a single MAF object.

name: rds_to_maf
description: Convert an RDS MAF object into a standard MAF TSV file usable by all maftools tools.

name: list_genes
description: List all unique genes in the MAF file.

name: list_samples
description: List all unique Tumor_Sample_Barcodes in the MAF file.

name: summarize_maf
description: Summarize MAF file and return sample stats.

name: plot_summary
description: Generate mutation summary plot.

name: plot_oncoplot
description: Takes output generated by read.maf and draws an oncoplot.

name: plot_titv
description: Plot Transition and Transversion (Ti/Tv) ratios.

name: plot_vaf
description: Plots vaf distribution of genes as a boxplot.

name: math_score
description: Calcuates Mutant-Allele Tumor Heterogeneity (MATH) scores from variant allele frequencies.

name: plot_lollipop
description: Draws lollipop plot of amino acid changes. Protein domains are derived from PFAM database.

name: plot_rainfall
description: Generate rainfall plot for a specific Tumor_Sample_Barcode.

name: plot_tcga_compare
description: Compares mutation load in input MAF against all of 33 TCGA cohorts.

name: tcga_available
description: List available TCGA studies.

name: pcawg_available
description: List available PCAWG studies.

name: load_tcga_data
description:
Load TCGA MAF dataset.
  - tcga_data/{study}.rds   (MAF object)
  - tcga_data/{study}.maf   (tab-delimited MAF table)

name: load_pcawg_data
description:
Load PCAWG MAF dataset.
  - pcawg_data/{study}.rds
  - pcawg_data/{study}.maf

name: plot_cooncoplot
description:
Generate a coOncoplot with full parameter customization
for:
  - TCGA vs User MAF, or
  - User vs User MAF.

name: plot_cobarplot
description:
Draw two barplots side by side for cohort comparision:
  - TCGA vs User
  - User vs User

name: plot_lollipopPlot2
description:
Generate a lollipopPlot2 comparing:
  - TCGA vs User MAF (if tcga_rds_path provided)
  - User vs User MAF (if user_maf_path2 provided)

Use m1_label and m2_label to select amino-acid positions for labels. Each accepts a positive integer, a list of positive integers, "all", or null/[] for no labels. Set label_top_variant=true to automatically label each cohort's most frequent protein change, including ties. Automatic labeling cannot be combined with nonempty m1_label or m2_label.

name: compare_maf_forestplot
description:
Compare two cohorts using mafCompare and create a forestPlot.
Supports:
  - TCGA vs User
  - User vs User

name: trinucleotide_matrix
description:
Extract single 5' and 3' bases flanking the mutated site for de-novo signature analysis.
Also estimates APOBEC enrichment scores.

name: estimate_signatures
description: Estimate number of signatures based on cophenetic correlation metric.

name: plot_cophenetic
description: Draw an elbow plot of cophenetic correlation metric.

name: extract_signatures
description: Decompose a matrix of 96 substitution classes into n signatures.

name: compare_signatures
description: Compare identified de novo mutational signatures against known COSMIC signatures.

name: plot_signatures
description: Plot extracted mutational signatures derived from NMF decomposition.

name: clinical_enrichment
description: Performs mutational enrichment analysis for a given clinical feature.

name: signature_enrichment
description: Performs mutational signature enrichment analysis and saves the plot.

name: drug_interactions
description: Checks for drug-gene interactions and druggable categories.

name: filter_maf
description:
Filter MAF by genes or Tumor Sample Barcode (tsb).

Outputs:
    - filtered_maf.rds  : filtered MAF object
    - filtered_maf.tsv  : filtered mutation table

name: subset_maf
description:
Subset MAF using sample names, gene names, mutation conditions,
clinical filters, genomic ranges, or custom queries.

Outputs:
    - subset_maf.rds : Result as a MAF object / data.frame
    - subset_maf.tsv : Subset mutation table

name: genes_to_barcodes
description:
Extract Tumor Sample Barcodes where specified genes are mutated.

Outputs:
    - genes_to_barcodes.rds  (R object for downstream MCP / R usage)
    - genes_to_barcodes.tsv  (structured table)

name: genotype_matrix
description:
Generate a genotype matrix (genes x samples) from a MAF file.

Output:
    - genotype_matrix.tsv (structured matrix table)

name: get_clinical_data
description: Extract clinical annotation table from a MAF object or TCGA RDS object.

name: get_fields
description:
Retrieve all available fields/columns present in the MAF data table.

Output:
    - maf_fields.tsv

name: get_gene_summary
description:
Generate gene-level summary statistics from either:
  - a MAF file (SNV/INDEL summary via maftools), or
  - a GISTIC RDS object.

Output:
    - gene_summary.tsv

name: tcga_available_gistic
description: List available TCGA GISTIC studies.

name: load_tcga_gistic
description:
Load TCGA GISTIC CNV dataset using TCGAgistic.

Args:
    cancer_name: TCGA cohort abbreviation or full cancer name
    copy_number_level: one of "all", "deep", "shallow"
    output_dir: directory to save the loaded RDS object

Returns:
    Status message with saved file path.

name: get_sample_summary
description:
Extract per-sample summary statistics from either:
  - a MAF object (mutation summary via maftools::getSampleSummary), or
  - a GISTIC object (CNV summary via TCGAgistic::getSampleSummary).

Output:
    - sample_summary.tsv (structured data table)

name: gistic_bubble_plot
description: Plots significantly altered cytobands as a function of number samples in which it is altered and number genes it contains. Size of each bubble is according to -log10 transformed q values.

name: gistic_chrom_plot
description: A genomic plot with segments highlighting signififcant Amplifications and Deletion regions.

name: gistic_oncoplot
description: Draw CNV oncoplot-style heatmap using GISTIC data.

name: infer_heterogeneity
description:
Clusters variants based on Variant Allele Frequencies (VAF)
and visualizes tumor heterogeneity.

name: mutcount_matrix
description: Generates a count matrix of mutations. i.e, number of mutations per gene per sample.

name: oncodrive
description:
Clusters variants based on their position to detect disease causing genes.
Expects maf_path to be an RDS file containing a MAF object.

name: pathway_enrichment
description: Checks for enrichment of known oncogenic pathways and plots result.

name: plot_pfam_domains
description: Summarizes amino acid positions and annotates them with pfam domain information.

name: plot_apobec_diff
description: Plots differences between APOBEC enriched and non-APOBEC enriched samples

name: plot_maf_survgroup
description: Performs survival analysis for a geneset(for TCGA).

name: plot_maf_survgroup_custom
description: Survival analysis for CUSTOM user-uploaded MAF + clinical CSV.

name: oncodrive_analysis
description:
Clusters variants based on their position to detect disease causing genes.
Expects maf_path to be an RDS file containing a MAF object.

name: plot_cbs_segments
description: Plots segmented copy number data.

name: prepare_mutsig
description: Correct gene symbols for MutSig compatibility.

name: plot_tmb
description: Estimates Tumor Mutation Burden per megabase.

name: plot_vaf_compare
description: Compare VAF distributions between two cohorts.

name: export_r_script
description:
Export the R code generated by an existing Maftools-MCP tool without executing R.

This internal validation utility captures the actual ro.r(...) script assembled by
the selected MCP tool after applying the same Python-side parameter defaults and
conversion logic used during normal MCP execution.
